_comment: Copy to config/command-center.local.json (gitignored). rootIssue = the tracker issue whose direct children are the big events. carsExport.path = the JSON written every minute by tools/command-center/export-cars.mjs (run it with --signals-dir to get the waiting queue). The tracker API key is NOT here: it comes from the personal config (personal.linear.apiKey or the default key file). Phase 2 blocks are optional — leave one out and that block shows 'not connected': ownerPending.path = the decision list (schema nanocc-owner-pending/v1, see docs/product/COMMAND_CENTER_CONTRACTS.md); waiting.ignoreTagPrefixes = car tags hidden from the waiting queue (scheduled jobs whose flags are never accepted; hidden items are still counted); quota.dir = directory with one header-reading JSON per pool, staleSeconds = when a reading counts as old (default 900).
